subject: english
stem: Sara looks tired after every long practice. Why does looks stay in the simple present?
options: Because this happens after every long practice and Look! marks a past action.
Because looks always means to watch.
Because this happens after every long practice; Look! is not used here.

optionRationales.reason: every long practice 支持反覆情況，但 Look! 指向眼前狀態，不標記過去動作。
looks 在此表示看起來，不是觀看，而且 always 的說法過度。
every long practice 建立反覆情況，句首也沒有命令語 Look!。
Sara 是單數，這正是 looks 加 -s 的原因。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 此處 look 是句中動詞 looks，配合每次練習後的重複狀態，不是 Look! 命令。
第三項同時辨認字義位置與 every 的週期，能排除只看到 look 就選進行式的誤判。
